name: Rifugio Vittorio Emanuele II, Gran Paradiso
region: Gran Paradiso National Park, Aosta Valley
why: A mule track through larches and ibex pastures to the silver-roofed hut of the Gran Paradiso climbers, under the glaciers of Ciarforon.
book: Nothing for a day walk. Park at Pont (end of the road). Sleeping: book the hut (CAI Turin) well ahead, it is the base for the Gran Paradiso climb.
water: Streams on the lower half; the hut sells drinks April to September.
dangers: Above 2,700 m: cold, and snow on the path until late June.
Storms in the afternoon: the upper part is open moraine.
turnaround: If you are not at the hut by 13:00, turn back.

points.name: Pont, Valsavarenche
points.note: 1,960 m: the end of the road, meadows by the river. Cross the bridge and take path 1.

points.name: Gran Paradiso from the moraine
points.note: Out of the larches the track zigzags up open ground; the glaciers of the Gran Paradiso group come into view.

points.name: Rifugio Vittorio Emanuele II
points.note: 2,735 m: the half-barrel silver hut by Lago di Moncorvé, ibex around it.
